criteria.text: When an unauthenticated user requests a protected resource, the system shall deny access.
When a user lacking the admin permission opens the admin surface, the system shall render the access-denied state.
When labelled sample data is available, the classifier shall reach the agreed accuracy threshold.
criteria.disposition: Blocked on client-supplied labelled sample set (open item O8); fallback shipped and evidenced under AUTH-C2 pattern; revisit at phase exit.

criteria.text: When the record type changes, the system shall show only the fields relevant to that type (computed display, not merely a hidden attribute).
When the form is posted with a missing prerequisite value, the system shall redirect to a friendly error state, never a raw 4xx/5xx.
